name: v1.1.3
body:
## What's Changed
* scx_loader: move default config test fixture to a TOML file by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/59
* scx_loader/scxctl: improved profile support  by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/60
* scx_loader/scxctl: improved profile support part 2 by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/61
* scxctl: fix clippy error by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/62
* scx_loader/scxctl: improved profile support part 3 by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/64
* scxctl: unify error handling by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/65
* scxtui: add D-Bus scheduler management TUI by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/66
* scxtui: improve responsiveness, state synchronization, and feedback by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/68
* scxctl: support shell-style scheduler arguments by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/69
* scxtui: preview mode arguments and support session-only custom args by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/70
* scx_loader: sync flags with scx repo by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/74
* versions: bump versions for 1.1.3 release by @vnepogodin in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/pull/75


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sched-ext/scx-loader/compare/v1.1.2...v1.1.3
